nodes.label: ADR 0031: Review Check Downgrade and Identity Boundary
Non-Identity Check Downgrade Boundary
nodes.rationale: Measured 146.7 wasted provider-minutes and one 67.4-minute close-out window where the same user reply had to be confirmed 4 times; checks that carry no identity, order, hash or required-artifact binding become quality facts (partial/warn/record), while identity checks keep fail-loud strength (CONSTITUTION.md:28).
